mapper.select: SELECT 'board' AS board_type, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'Y') AS total_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'N') AS hidden_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_BOARD_REPLY WHERE STATUS = 'Y') AS comment_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_BOARD_LIKE) AS like_cnt FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'activity' AS board_type, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'Y') AS total_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'N') AS hidden_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_ACTIVITY_REPLY WHERE STATUS = 'Y') AS comment_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_ACTIVITY_LIKE) AS like_cnt FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'campaign' AS board_type, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_CAMPAIGN WHERE STATUS = 'Y') AS total_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_CAMPAIGN WHERE STATUS = 'N') AS hidden_cnt, NULL AS comment_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_CAMPAIGN_LIKE) AS like_cnt FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'notice' AS board_type, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_NOTICE WHERE STATUS = 'Y') AS total_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_NOTICE WHERE STATUS = 'N') AS hidden_cnt, NULL AS comment_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_NOTICE_ATTACHMENT) AS like_cnt FROM DUAL

SELECT 'board' AS boardType, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CL_BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT 'activity' AS boardType, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT 'campaign' AS boardType, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CL_CAMPAIGN WHERE STATUS = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT 'notice' AS boardType, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CL_NOTICE WHERE STATUS = 'N'

SELECT r.REGION_NO AS regionNo, r.REGION_NAME AS regionName, SUM(t.count) AS totalCount FROM ( SELECT REGION_NO, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CL_BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'Y' GROUP BY REGION_NO UNION ALL SELECT REGION_NO, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'Y' GROUP BY REGION_NO ) t JOIN CL_REGION_CATEGORY r ON t.REGION_NO = r.REGION_NO GROUP BY r.REGION_NO, r.REGION_NAME ORDER BY totalCount DESC
SELECT r.REGION_NO, r.REGION_NAME, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM CL_BOARD b JOIN CL_REGION_CATEGORY r ON b.REGION_NO = r.REGION_NO WHERE b.STATUS = 'Y' GROUP BY r.REGION_NO, r.REGION_NAME
SELECT r.REGION_NO, r.REGION_NAME, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD a JOIN CL_REGION_CATEGORY r ON a.REGION_NO = r.REGION_NO WHERE a.STATUS = 'Y' GROUP BY r.REGION_NO, r.REGION_NAME

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT BOARD_TITLE AS title, VIEW_COUNT AS views, 'board' AS boardType FROM CL_BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE AS title, VIEW_COUNT AS views, 'activity' AS boardType FROM CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT CAMPAIGN_TITLE AS title, VIEW_COUNT AS views, 'campaign' AS boardType FROM CL_CAMPAIGN WHERE STATUS = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT NOTICE_TITLE AS title, VIEW_COUNT AS views, 'notice' AS boardType FROM CL_NOTICE WHERE STATUS = 'Y' ) t ORDER BY views DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
